taskDecomposition.strategy: Sequential 3-task approach for detailed pseudocode development

task1.name: Core Domain & Persistence Foundations

finalAdjustmentsApplied.splitQuery: Removed global, apply per hotspot only
finalAdjustmentsApplied.auditInterceptor: Registered via AddInterceptors() on DbContext options
finalAdjustmentsApplied.collectionOrdering: Via aggregate accessors, no ordered Include

task1.objective: Establish C# domain model, EF mappings, and DB schema for strongly-typed Conversation aggregate
components: ChatDbContext with EF type conversions and audit mappings
PostgreSQL migrations with extensions and indexes
successCriteria: Typed IDs with EF Core conversion working
Entity CRUD operations functional with audit fields

task2.name: Data Access & Transaction Orchestration
task2.objective: Implement generic + narrow repos, UoW façade, and auditing interceptor for safe transactional writes
components: Generic repository pattern with IGenericRepository<TEntity, TId> interface
EfRepositoryBase<TEntity, TId> implementation with optimized queries
Narrow repositories (ConversationRepository, MessageRepository) with compiled queries
Unit of Work facade with transaction orchestration and event coordination
Optimistic concurrency handling with retry logic and exponential backoff
Safe transactional write operations with batch processing and error handling
successCriteria: Generic + narrow repository pattern with compiled query optimizations
UoW facade managing transactions without DbContext re-implementation
Audit interceptor with proper AddInterceptors() registration and DI lifetimes
Optimistic concurrency with xmin and retry logic
Safe transactional write operations with comprehensive error handling
Production-clean patterns ready for Phase 4 implementation

task3.name: Eventing & Read-Model Projections
task3.objective: Build Outbox pattern and CQRS read side for reliable domain event flow to denormalized tables
components: OutboxEvent entity with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED PostgreSQL optimization
OutboxService with atomic persistence and immediate processing triggers
OutboxEventDispatcher background service with advanced retry policies
Scoped Event Sourcing with selective application where audit trail is critical
ConversationReadModel with full-text search and jsonb support
Event handlers for async projections with error recovery
PostgreSQL chat schema with GIN indexes and performance optimization
successCriteria: Outbox pattern with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED concurrency
Background dispatcher with graceful shutdown and lifecycle management
Scoped Event Sourcing applied selectively where justified
CQRS read models with PostgreSQL full-text search optimization
Comprehensive error handling and recovery strategies
Production-ready eventing system ready for Phase 3 Architecture
